summary: TRACKMIND minimalist GUI revision — frontend-only smoke + visual regression on Expo web preview at mobile viewport (390x844). All redesigned screens render cleanly with 0 console errors and 0 pageerrors. Login (TRACKMIND wordmark + dot, two underlined inputs, eye toggle, FaceID switch, ENTER TERMINAL pill, demo creds at bottom), Dashboard (top bar + PAPER chip + 2 icon buttons, $10,000.00 hero bankroll @~56pt, today PnL row with dot separators, single-column engine list with dot+name+meta+bar+%, Top Signal card showing Micro 15.57% edge, Master Allocator with stats + AUTO-DEPLOY pill), Signals (26 rows after fetch — engine dot + market title + engine/side/edge meta + right-aligned conf% with hairline progress bar; tap expands inline; APPROVE creates a position), Positions (engine-dot + ARB chip + hero +$315.54 PnL on left, entry 0.826 → mark 1.000 on right), Micro (6 arb cards, hero +15.57% net edge at top, YES/NO leg cards with git-merge icon between, EXECUTE ARB pill), Analytics (hero TOTAL P&L card with sparkline + trades/win%/sharpe sub-row, 2x2 stat grid avg-win/avg-loss/max-dd/trades, BY ENGINE breakdown rows). Controls modal + Settings modal still open and Logout returns to Login. Backend regression: pytest 19/19 PASSED in 4.7s — backend untouched and confirmed healthy. All required testIDs from the request are present and selectable. Approve-to-position end-to-end flow verified (signal → position card with +21.04% PnL).

issues: Bottom tab buttons still have no testID (tabBarButtonTestID). Carried over from iter 1 — not blocking; navigated via /signals /positions /micro /analytics URLs. Optional add for stable bottom-nav automation.

Initial render of /signals takes ~2-3s before rows appear (cache fetch). First Playwright pass at 0ms saw 0 rows; after wait_for_timeout(3000) it shows 26. Recommend a small skeleton/loading state on the Signals screen for perceived responsiveness.

action_items: (Optional) Add tabBarButtonTestID to each Tabs.Screen in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx so Playwright can tap bottom tabs directly.
(Optional) Add a lightweight loading skeleton/placeholder on /signals while the first fetch resolves (~2-3s).
critical_code_review_comments: theme.ts redesign is clean: single accent layer per surface, hairline borders (#16161A), tabular-nums on metric type, hero 56pt — matches Bloomberg-meets-Apple intent.
All 7 redesigned screens reuse engineColor()/hexAlpha() and StyleSheet.create — no className or CSS leaked into RN.

All required testIDs from the request are present (verified by grep + selector hits): brand-logo, email-input, password-input, login-submit-button, biometric-switch, login-error, login-demo-creds, go-to-register-link, bankroll-value-text, today-pnl-value-text, top-signal-card, auto-deploy-button, engine-{alpha,quant,whale,micro}-card, open-controls-button, open-settings-button, filter-{all,alpha,quant,whale,micro}, signal-row-*, approve-*, position-*, arb-*, arb-leg-yes, arb-leg-no, arb-execute-*, stat-*.
